theme_strategy.overall: Dark Mode Only. Matches the night-time Indian street neon aesthetic, prevents screen glare inside autos, and creates a high-contrast environment.
theme_strategy.marketing: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) modified with 'Auto Rickshaw' colors. High-energy, immersive, motion-heavy.
theme_strategy.dashboard: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast). Utilitarian, data-dense, technical grid structures with flat surfaces.
theme_strategy.kiosk_player: High-visibility, bold typography, distraction-free with animated tickers. Built for direct sunlight or dark transit environments.

typography.heading_font: Clash Display or Cabinet Grotesk (for marketing impact and big numbers)
typography.body_font: Inter (for dense dashboard data and readable paragraphs)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for device IDs, coordinates, technical metrics in the dashboard)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders for Dashboards (border-collapse style, 1px solid #27272a). Glassmorphism (bg-zinc-900/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10) for Sticky Headers and Kiosk overlays.
visual_enhancers.lighting: Subtle yellow drop-shadows on primary buttons (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(250,204,21,0.5)]) for Marketing CTA.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the marketing hero background to feel like gritty urban transit.

layouts.marketing: Bento Grid (Tetris Mode) with wide gaps (gap-8), asymmetric overlapping elements.
layouts.dashboard: High-density Grid. Dense sidebars, border-r on layout, tight spacing (gap-4). Every pixel utilized, max-h-screen for main app frame to allow internal scrolling.
layouts.kiosk_player: Absolute positioning for overlays (News/Weather on bottom, QR on top right) over a full-screen looping media.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for Marketing. Sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm) for Dashboard to feel technical.
components.cards: Cardless design in Dashboard. Just direct grids with borders separating them. Hover state: slight lift and border color change.
components.tables: Dense Shadcn tables. Hover on row changes bg to zinc-900.
components.charts: Recharts. Use 'Auto Yellow' and 'Electric Cyan' for lines/bars. No grid lines, just axes for a clean look.

motion.marketing: Framer Motion staggered entrances. Smooth scrolling. Tracing beam on key feature cards.
motion.dashboard: Minimal. Instant snappy feedback. Subtle background color shifts on hover.
motion.kiosk: React Fast Marquee for news/weather ticker at the bottom.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA standards. Black text on Auto Yellow is highly readable. White text on Zinc 950 is high contrast.
accessibility.interactive: All buttons and links must have explicit hover colors. e.g. hover:bg-yellow-500
accessibility.data_testid: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute for testing.

marketing_hero_bg.description: Vibrant night street scene with neon lights (used as backdrop for marketing hero with heavy black gradient overlay)

auto_traffic_bg.description: Auto rickshaw driving at night (used in 'For Drivers' section)

player_mockup.description: People interacting with a digital display (used in 'For Advertisers' section to show engagement)

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize custom HTML/Tailwind over Shadcn for the marketing landing page to ensure a creative, non-generic layout.
For dashboards, use Shadcn but customize borders to 1px solid zinc-800 and remove heavy card shadows. Use a flat, technical aesthetic.
For the Kiosk Player, ensure the layout is 100vh/100vw with absolute hidden overflow to simulate Android fullscreen mode.
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for headers or overlays if content scrolls beneath them. Use bg-zinc-900/80 backdrop-blur-md.
Avoid typical generic 'SaaS Blue'. Use the Auto Yellow (#FACC15) as the primary CTA color.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons exclusively.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where necessary.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped for marketing, or sharp technical buttons for dashboard.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
